# Security test suite

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P2 · Proven identity](../README.md#phase-2--proven-identity) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:security-tests` · **Epic:** [#122](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/122) · **Tickets:** 4 (4M)

Adds a dedicated CI security suite that attacks the identity, token, mTLS and bundle paths with known-bad inputs. Regressions in any of these controls fail the build.

## How we build it

- Suite lives in new directory test/security as Go tests (build tag `security`) using in-process CP and worker servers plus test/fakes; wired into scripts/check.sh as a required stage.
- Token forgery: alg none, HS256 with public key as secret, wrong signing key, unknown kid, wrong aud/iss, missing exp; replay and expiry: expired token, nbf in future, reused assertion jti.
- Binding and misuse: cnf mismatch, token for agent A on agent B port, user outside allowed groups, disabled agent, blocked user (block-list applied within one long-poll cycle, asserted with a deadline).
- Transport and bundles: revoked worker cert, cert from foreign CA, expired cert, unsigned bundle, bad signature, rollback to older version, future issuedAt.
- Each case asserts the exact rejection reason metric/audit record, not just a non-200.

## Done when

scripts/check.sh runs the security suite on every PR and every listed attack case is rejected with the expected reason.

### 1/4 · W-P2-SECT-01

**Add security test harness with in-process CP, worker and Dex fake**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#123](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/123)

Create test/security with helpers that start the CP (token service, worker CA, bundle signing) and a worker in-process, plus a fake OIDC issuer in test/fakes that mints Dex-like ID tokens with controllable claims and keys. Add the `security` build tag stage to scripts/check.sh.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] check.sh runs the security stage and fails on a deliberately failing case
- [ ] Harness boot under 5s

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-WBND-03`](identity-enforcement.md#35--w-p2-wbnd-03) Implement identity require mode on HTTP, CONNECT and MCP paths

**Unblocks:** [`W-P2-SECT-02`](security-tests.md#24--w-p2-sect-02) Add token forgery and replay test cases; [`W-P2-SECT-03`](security-tests.md#34--w-p2-sect-03) Add binding, cross-agent and cross-user misuse cases; [`W-P2-SECT-04`](security-tests.md#44--w-p2-sect-04) Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases

### 2/4 · W-P2-SECT-02

**Add token forgery and replay test cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#124](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/124)

Cases for alg none, HS256 key confusion, wrong key, unknown kid, wrong aud/iss, expired, nbf future, missing exp, and reused client assertion jti; assert worker identity failure reason and CP denial reason.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Every case rejected with the expected reason label
- [ ] No case reaches the upstream fake

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SECT-01`](security-tests.md#14--w-p2-sect-01) Add security test harness with in-process CP, worker and Dex fake

### 3/4 · W-P2-SECT-03

**Add binding, cross-agent and cross-user misuse cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#125](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/125)

Cases for cnf mismatch, agent A token on agent B port, user not in allowed groups, disabled agent, and block-list timing: block a user via the policy API and assert their next request after one long-poll cycle (deadline = longPollWait + 2s) is denied.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Cross-agent use denied with agent_mismatch
- [ ] Blocked user denied within the deadline

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SECT-01`](security-tests.md#14--w-p2-sect-01) Add security test harness with in-process CP, worker and Dex fake

### 4/4 · W-P2-SECT-04

**Add worker cert and signed bundle attack cases**

Type **test** · Size **M** · Issue [#126](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/126)

Cases for revoked cert, foreign-CA cert, expired cert and no cert on /policy; unsigned bundle, single-byte tamper, unknown kid, version rollback and future issuedAt served via a malicious CP stub; assert worker keeps last-known-good policy.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Revoked cert gets 401 on next request
- [ ] Worker policy unchanged after each malicious bundle

**Depends on:** [`W-P2-SECT-01`](security-tests.md#14--w-p2-sect-01) Add security test harness with in-process CP, worker and Dex fake; [`W-P2-WCA-05`](worker-mtls.md#56--w-p2-wca-05) Implement worker cert revocation; [`W-P2-SBND-04`](signed-bundles.md#45--w-p2-sbnd-04) Verify bundles in RemoteProvider and keep last-known-good
